text:
harper-docs: opened a tiny PR to update the audit-log retention page and refresh SDK/CLI snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/821

riya-legal: quick legal flag: avoid absolutes like 'forever' or 'permanent' in public docs. SOC2 reviewers want explicit scope and a legal-hold exception.

ben-eng: noted. Also the SDK examples still use `expires_in` — new API expects a `retention_policy` object. Quick example fix:
```diff
- client.audit.create(tenant='acct_abc', expires_in=86400)
+ client.audit.create(tenant='acct_abc', retention_policy={'mode':'ttl','seconds':86400}, pseudonymize=True)
```

claire-privacy: proposed public sentence: "Audit logs are retained according to customer-configured retention policies; Redwood is not retaining logs beyond those settings except when required by law (e.g., legal holds)." Keeps it concise and audit-friendly.

riya-legal: tweak: prefer 'does not retain' over 'is not retaining'. Also remove any direct links to internal legal playbooks — add '(contact support)' instead.

harper-docs: switching to 'does not retain' and replacing internal link with support pointer. Adding a short CLI sample for migration docs:
```
# view retention
rctl audit get --tenant acct_abc --output json
# sample
{"tenant":"acct_abc","retention_policy":{"mode":"ttl","seconds":86400},"pseudonymize":true}
```

build-bot: PR #821 checks  unit-tests: passed, link-checker: warning (removed internal link), lint: passed

harper-docs: removed internal link and updated py/js/curl/cli snippets. @riya-legal @claire-privacy can you quick-approve? will merge after CI warning clears. Thanks! :sparkles:
